purpose: First-party facts from the maker's own documents, compared against data/specs/juki-tl-18qvp.json. Research input for the editor; not a spec file.

documents.note: Spec list, features, accessories, suggested retail price; no throat figure
Spec table; work-area diagram labels 8.5 in x 6 in arm
Specifications table; weight and foot lift differ from the page
Full spec table including 'arm size'; a Collector's Edition page, not the standard Haruka page

facts.value: Min. 55, max. 1,500 spm; speed slider 200 to 1,500

site.label: Speed
site.juki: 1,500 stitches per minute; the page also quotes 200 to 1,500 on the slider.

facts.value: 'Arm size' 8.5 in (W) x 6 in (H) on Juki Japan's Collector's Edition page and the brochure diagram; not on jukiquilting.com
facts.note: Juki's wording is 'arm size', not needle-to-arm; our 8.5 in has only this indirect maker source and dealers calling it throat space.

site.label: Throat
site.juki: Juki Japan and the brochure give an 8.5 x 6 in arm size; jukiquilting.com gives no figure.
site.others: Dealers call it 8.5 x 6 in throat space.

facts.value: Up to 23 in with the auxiliary table attached
25.4 lb / 11.5 kg (page, brochure); Japan page 24.5 lb; manual 11.9 kg
facts.note: Juki's own documents disagree (11.5 vs 11.9 kg).

site.label: Weight
site.juki: 25.4 lb (11.5 kg) on the page and brochure; the manual says 11.9 kg.

facts.value: 18 W x 14 H x 9 D in (452 x 350 x 219 mm)
Lever max 10 mm (0.4 in), knee lifter max 12 mm (0.5 in); manual says 7 mm and 9 mm (12 mm by knee lifter)
facts.spec_value: Knee lifter lever included; float function
facts.note: Juki's page and manual disagree on the lever lift.

facts.value: Float function (micro lifter): the presser foot floats 0 to 2 mm above the material
facts.spec_value: Float function (micro lifter) holds the presser foot 0 to 2 mm above the fabric

facts.value: HA x 1 (130/705H) / HL x 5, #9 to #18; high shank

facts.note: One owner says 1.1 A against the TL-2010Q's 1.4 A (Reddit, not a Juki figure).

facts.value: Automatic thread trimmer by button or foot controller; automatic needle threader
Vertical full-rotary hook on the feature page; the Japan spec table says horizontal-axis full-rotary
Standard, hemming, zipper, even feed, 1/5 in and 1/4 in quilting, open-toe quilting, 1/4 in compensating and 1/4 in feet; quilt guide; auxiliary table; knee lifter
facts.spec_value: Nine presser feet; power cord, two screwdrivers, HAx1 needles, four bobbins, knee lifter lever, oiler, spool cap, cleaning brush

facts.value: Juki America FAQ: 2 years on motors, light assembly, wiring, switches, circuit boards and speed control; 5 years on other parts for factory defects
facts.spec_value: 5 yr defective materials and workmanship; 2 yr motors, light assembly, wiring, switches, speed control and electrical components
facts.note: General Juki America wording, not TL-18QVP-specific.

site.label: Warranty
site.juki: 2 years on motor and electrical parts, 5 years on other factory defects (Juki America FAQ, general).

facts.value: Suggested retail $2,369; contact an authorized Juki QVP dealer
'constructed of aluminum die-casting that ensures industrial-quality sewing'; 'equipped with the same mechanism as JUKI's industrial machines'; 'known as a workhorse'
facts.note: Marketing wording; claims only (rule 7). Juki gives no meaning for 'VP' or 'QVP' beyond a product-line label.

facts.value: jukiquilting.com: 23(W) x 14(D) in written with 'mm' unit typo, 590(W) x 355(D) mm; brochure and Japan page: 590(W) x 335(D) mm (13 in)
facts.note: Juki's page and brochure disagree on the auxiliary table depth (355 vs 335 mm).
